full_query: Do fissures and hemmroids heal on their own?

shared_context.topic: whether hemorrhoids and anal fissures heal on their own

sentences: Most hemorrhoids are self-limiting and can heal on their own over time, but not all hemorrhoids or fissures have the potential to heal spontaneously
For hemorrhoids, studies have shown that most small, internal hemorrhoids (grade 1 or 2) can resolve on their own without treatment within 1-2 months
However, larger internal hemorrhoids (grade 3 or 4) or those with significant prolapse may not heal without treatment and may require medical or surgical intervention
Regarding anal fissures, most acute fissures can heal on their own within 6-8 weeks, but the healing process can be prolonged in some cases
A study found that 80% of patients with acute fissures achieved healing within 6 weeks, while the remaining 20% required additional treatment
However, chronic fissures may not heal without treatment and may require medical or surgical intervention
A study found that 10% of patients with chronic fissures did not heal after conservative treatment and required surgical intervention
